A page that reaches the page limit must be followed by another page; an empty final page with the accurate document disposition may certify that no distinct facts remain. These are semantic coverage families, not a deterministic keyword checklist. Do not repeat an accepted quote with the same normalized economic identity and do not infer a fact or absence from silence. Do not turn general background or adjacent technical history into production facts merely because it is economically interesting. Never use snippets, future outcomes, score, or Stage.
